title: Legal Skyes Notice of Dispute
use_case: Customer-facing notice form for Legal Skyes in-house dispute committee intake.

sections.heading: Internal Review Boundary
sections.body: The Legal Skyes in-house dispute committee is an internal company review process. It is not a court, law firm, legal representation, neutral arbitration forum, judicial judgment, or arbitral award.

sections.heading: Notice
sections.body: Customer {{customer_name}} gives notice of a dispute for order {{order_id}}, account/workspace {{account_or_workspace}}, product or service {{product_or_service}}, and amount paid {{amount_paid}}.

sections.heading: Evidence
sections.body: Evidence listed by customer: {{evidence_list}}. Sensitive credentials, private keys, payment card numbers, and unrelated personal data should be redacted before submission.

sections.heading: Rights Preserved
sections.body: Nothing in this notice process prohibits truthful lawful reviews, good-faith consumer reports, regulator reports, law-enforcement reports, small-claims filings where available, payment-network rights, or other rights that cannot legally be waived.
